name: NTR_OH_bar
xsql:
SELECT 
    name AS OHS_Name, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY payout DESC) AS Final_Rank, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prospera_payout DESC) AS Prospera_Rank, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY renasight_payout DESC) AS Renasight_Rank, 
   '$' || Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(payout, 0), '#,###'), '0') AS Total_Payout
FROM (
    SELECT 
        -- Using part.name as requested, with a safe parse just in case there are parentheses 
        CASE 
            WHEN IndexOf(part.name, '(') > 0 THEN SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) 
            ELSE part.name 
        END AS name, 
        
        -- Aggregate Payouts
        SUM(p.amount) AS payout,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Prospera' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS prospera_payout,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Renasight' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS renasight_payout
        
    FROM xactly.xc_payment p
    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant part
        ON p.participant_id = part.participant_id
    
    -- 1. Embedded Title Mapping
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
            pta.title_name AS title_name
        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
            ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
            ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
            ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
    ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
    
    -- 2. Embedded Territory Mapping
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
            pa_active.territory AS territory
        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
            ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
            ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
    ) ter ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id

    -- 3. Master Mapping
    INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
        ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
       AND pta.title_name = m.title
       
    -- 4. Territory Mapping (Still needed for sub_category fallback, but region logic removed)
    LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
        ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
    
    WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
      AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
      AND m.category = 'OH'
      
    GROUP BY 
        part.name
) BaseData
ORDER BY Final_Rank ASC;
